Reduce. amountMinor is the new REMAINING hold (0 or more); it never raises it (not-a-reduction, 422). Reducing to zero closes the hold (VOIDED when nothing was captured, otherwise CAPTURED). A hold that is not AUTHORIZED is 409 illegal-transition.
